desc_about_settings: The file on disk that holds the current configuration
desc_about_version: Shared by the window and the background service
desc_accel: Extra pointer gain proportional to how fast the mouse moves
desc_capture_mouse_buttons: Clicks go to the target while it has control
desc_edge_inset: How close to the PC screen edge the cursor has to get
desc_edge_trigger_enabled: The toggle key switches this while running
desc_enter_cooldown: Seconds before the same edge can be crossed again
desc_exit_clear_distance: How far the cursor is placed back inside the PC screen on exit
desc_forward_consumer_keys: Volume and transport keys go to the target
desc_invert_wheel_h: Horizontal scrolling is reversed on the target
desc_invert_wheel_v: Vertical scrolling is reversed on the target
desc_nearby_note: Nearby BLE does not include this PC
desc_page_edge: Where the target sits, and where the keyboard and mouse change hands
desc_page_generic: Startup, maintenance and what is running
desc_page_keyboard: Keys the PC keeps for itself, and what the target receives
desc_page_pointer: How mouse movement reaches the target
desc_page_status: What the bridge is doing right now
desc_panic_keys: Releases the keyboard and mouse back to the PC at once
desc_pullback_distance: Pull-back distance needed for control to return
desc_pullback_exit: Pulling the pointer towards the PC returns control
desc_remap: Key remapping for the target device; right-click a field to choose from the full list
desc_sensitivity: 1.0 moves the target pointer as far as the PC cursor
desc_side: Which side of the PC the target device sits on
desc_start_hidden: Open with the notification area icon only, without this window
desc_start_with_windows: One value under HKCU Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, holding the command line; nothing else is written
desc_status_mode: Which side has the keyboard and mouse
desc_status_travel: Motion since the target was entered, negative on the way back
desc_toggle_edge_keys: Turns the pointer's screen crossing on or off
desc_type_clipboard_keys: Sends the PC clipboard to the target as ASCII characters
msg_advertisement_cut_short: the advertisement was cut short — see the Log
msg_advertising_as_keyboard_mouse_waitin: advertising as a keyboard and mouse — waiting for the target device to pair
msg_advertising_as_name_waiting_target: advertising as {name} — waiting for the target device to pair
msg_clipboard_holds_no_text_this: The clipboard holds no text this layout can type
msg_connected_since_time_target_device: connected since {time} — the target device is subscribed
msg_could_not_change_startup_entry: Could not change the startup entry
msg_name_cannot_be_set_from: {name} cannot be set from the settings file
msg_name_must_be_list_key: {name} must be a list of key names
msg_not_advertising_yet: not advertising yet — the Log says why
msg_remap_must_be_object_from: remap must be an object of {from: to} key names
msg_remap_row_needs_key: {label}: every row needs a key on both sides
msg_remap_values_must_be_key: remap values must be key names
msg_reset_every_setting_its_default: Reset every setting to its default value?
msg_side_must_be_one_options: side must be one of {options}, got {value}
msg_side_must_be_string_got: side must be a string, got {kind}
